caption: The drawing depicts two objects arranged on a plain, off-white background. One object is a pair of brown, metal tongs or pincers with two long, curved arms that extend downward and slightly outward, meeting at a narrow joint at the top. The second object is a straight, cylindrical rod of a similar brown color, positioned horizontally behind the upper part of the tongs, passing through the open space formed by the tongs’ arms. The rod appears to be slightly textured and is approximately perpendicular to the main vertical orientation of the tongs. The overall composition is centered, with the objects depicted in a naturalistic style, and the artist's name, "Arthur E. Reynolds," is written in small letters below and to the right of the objects. The drawing uses shades of brown and gray for the objects, with the background remaining plain and unmarked except for some faint stains near the edges.
title: Digging Tool
